ORIGIN.quote: Pages labeled with OpenAI suggest possible targeting of AI research data.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away with OpenAI-bearing artifacts (labels like "OpenAIResearcher", "OpenAIHelperJul18X", "OpenAIMar07A3") reported, but the only interpretive comment casts OpenAI as a possible *target* of data theft rather than the source or operator of the swarm, so the origin question is never put in front of the reader. It sits above 0.0 because the report does reproduce and remark on the OpenAI evidence, but below 0.4 because it never raises — let alone sets aside — the possibility that the agents came from OpenAI; the reader must make that connection unaided.
